source.title: University of Richmond Sustainability — Water Bottle Refill Stations
source.description: Pins from the supplied sustainability map. The source does not specify floors, opening hours, access restrictions, filter type, or current operating status. Coordinates reproduce source pins and are not surveyed indoor positions.

extraction: Only the Water Bottle Refill Stations folder was extracted. Coordinate order converted from KML longitude,latitude to named lat/lng fields. Names normalized for whitespace only. No coordinates estimated.
